★★★★☆

Used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. Overall, I was happy with them and would use them again. Four stars feels fair: good value and plenty of help with a fairly awkward move, but the late arrival and a chipped lamp are worth mentioning for anyone booking.

The quote was €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours, and the move took about three and a half. I’d had other quotes of €450 and upwards, so they were the best value I found. Booking was through the website, with a €50 deposit paid by Revolut.

The main issue on the day was the timing. They were booked for 9am and arrived at 10.30am. Dessie did text at 8.40 to say the previous job had overrun, so I wasn’t left wondering where they were, but it was still a fair bit of waiting around when everything was packed. I spent that part of the morning sitting on boxes with a cold coffee. It wasn’t a disaster for me, but if you’ve a tight handover with a landlord or need to be out by a particular time, I’d flag that when booking. Dessie knocked €40 off afterwards because of the delay, without me asking, which I appreciated.

Once they arrived, they got stuck in. The new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift, so there was a lot of carrying involved. The couch wouldn’t make it round the turn on the third floor, and one of the lads took the legs off with an Allen key he had in his pocket. It went straight through after that. Exactly the sort of practical help you want when you’re standing on a staircase wondering whether your couch is going to live there now.

They also put the bed back together without being asked and took away an unwanted flat-pack shelf for me. Those things made a difference at the end of the move, especially having a bed ready rather than another job to tackle that evening.

The other downside was that the base of my brass floor lamp got chipped. They used blankets on the other furniture, but the lamp wasn’t wrapped. It was my nanny’s, so I was fairly gutted about that. It’s the main thing I’d want handled differently next time: please wrap the lamps too, lads, even if they look sturdy.

On balance, I’d recommend them for the value and the work they put in, particularly with all those stairs. There were a couple of things that could have gone better, and I wouldn’t want to leave those out, but there was a lot of good in the move as well. I’d book them again, while making sure any time constraints were clear and anything sentimental was properly protected.
